Title: Parana

Blurb: The United Kingdom moves the capital of the Crown Colony of the United Province of Canada from Toronto back to the city of Quebec.

Title: Cuba

Blurb: Little War against Spanish rule in Cuba leads to rebel defeat, from 1879 to 1880.

Title: Portuguese Guinea

Title: Zulu Kingdom
Blurb: Anglo-Zulu War results in British victory and the annexation of the Zulu Kingdom.

Title: Antofagasta
Blurb: Chile occupies Antofagasta, previously Bolivian but with a Chilean majority population, starting the War of the Pacific against Bolivia and later Peru. Chile also occupies the coast north to the Loa River, and Bolivia loses direct access to the Pacific.

Title: Calama
Blurb: Chile occupies Calama from Bolivia after the Battle of Topater.

Title: Ryukyu Kingdom
Blurb: The Ryukyu Kingdom is annexed by the Japanese Empire.

Title: Western Triangle Island
Blurb: The United States of America claims Western Triangle Island, already claimed by Mexico, under the Guano Islands Act.

Title: Electric lighting
Blurb: Introduction of the widespread use of electric lighting. These included early crude systems in France and the UK and the introduction of large scale outdoor arc lighting systems by 1880.

Title: French Congo
Blurb: The French Republic establishes the protectorate of French Congo. Brazzaville is the capital.

Title: South African Republic
Blurb: First Boer War begins, lasting from 1880 to 1881.

Title: Tegucigalpa
Blurb: The Republic of Honduras moves its capital from Comayagua to Tegucigalpa, ending a century of indecision as to the country's capital.

Title: Buenos Aires
Blurb: Buenos Aires is declared the official capital of the Argentine Republic.

Title: Flint Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom claims Flint Island, disputing a claim by the United States of America.

Title: France
Blurb: 1881-1882: The Jules Ferry laws are passed in France establishing free, secular education.

Title: Mahdist State
Blurb: In the Sudan, Muhammad Ahmad claims to be the Mahdi, founding the Mahdist State and declaring war on the Khedivate of Egypt.

Title: Russian Empire
Blurb: 1881: Wave of pogroms begins in the Russian Empire.

Title: Sudan
Blurb: Mahdist War in Sudan, from 1881 to 1899. A depiction of the Battle of Omdurman in 1898 shows Winston Churchill taking part in a cavalry charge.

Title: Tunisia
Blurb: Tunisia becomes a French protectorate.

Title: Lima
Blurb: Chile starts the Occupation of Lima, Peru, during the War of the Pacific that lasts until October 23, 1883.

Title: Patagonia and Tierra del Fuego
Blurb: The border between Chile and Argentina is defined, dividing the previously disputed Patagonia and Tierra del Fuego between them and recognising the Strait of Magellan as Chilean waters with free access for all nations.

Title: South African Republic
Blurb: The South African Republic (Republic of Transvaal) regains self-governance under British suzerainty.

Title: Egypt
Blurb: Anglo-Egyptian War: British invasion and subsequent occupation of Egypt.

Title: Pearl Street Station
Blurb: Introduction of large scale electric power utilities with the Edison Holborn Viaduct (London) and Pearl Street (New York) power stations supplying indoor electric lighting using Edison's incandescent bulb.
Place: New York, New York, United States

Title: Tuberculosis bacilli
Blurb: Robert Koch discovered the tuberculosis bacilli. In the 19th century, the disease killed an estimated 25% of the adult population of Europe.

Title: Morant Cays and Pedro Cays
Blurb: The United Kingdom annexes Morant Cays and Pedro Cays as part of Jamaica.

Title: Kingdom of Loango
Blurb: The Kingdom of Loango is annexed to French Congo.

Title: Neuquen Province
Blurb: Argentina incorporates the Patagonian lands of modern Neuquen Province to the Limay River.

Title: Wassoulou Empire
Blurb: Mandingo Wars between the French colonial empire and the Wassoulou Empire of the Mandingo people led by Samory Toure, from 1883 to 1898.

Title: Quagga
Blurb: 1883: The quagga is rendered extinct.

Title: Krakatoa
Blurb: 1883: Krakatoa volcano explosion, one of the largest in modern history.

Title: Tarapaca, Arica and Tacna
Blurb: Chile gains Tarapaca permanently, and Arica, and Tacna from Peru (Treaty of Ancon). Arica and Tacna are subject to a future referendum in 10 years, which doesn't happen.

Title: Annam and Tonkin
Blurb: Annam and Tonkin become protectorates of France.

Title: Berlin Conference
Blurb: The Berlin Conference of 1884-1885 attempted to reach agreement on colonial borders in Africa, but disputes continued, both amongst European powers and in resistance by the native populations.

Title: German East Africa
Blurb: German East Africa is created.

Title: German New Guinea
Blurb: German New Guinea is created and administered by the German New Guinea Company.

Title: German South-West Africa
Blurb: German South-West Africa is created.

Title: Greenwich prime meridian
Blurb: The Greenwich prime meridian becomes the international standard reference for the determination of longitude by cartographers.

Title: Kamerun
Blurb: Kamerun is created.

Title: Territory of Basutoland
Blurb: The United Kingdom establishes the Crown Colony of the Territory of Basutoland. Maseru is the capital.

Title: Togoland
Blurb: Togoland is created.

Title: Antofagasta
Blurb: Chile regains Antofagasta from Bolivia legally as part of the truce ending the War of the Pacific (made permanent in 1904).

Title: Alacrans Islands
Blurb: The United States of America claims Alacrans Islands, already claimed by Mexico, under the Guano Islands Act.

Title: South African Republic
Blurb: The British suzerainty in the South African Republic (Republic of Transvaal) ends.

Title: Eastern Patagonia
Blurb: Argentina ends the conquest campaign of Eastern Patagonia, subduing the remaining Amerindian resistance in the modern Provinces of Chubut and Santa Cruz.

Title: Africa
Blurb: The Congo Conference in Berlin forms the basis for the division of Africa into colonies in the subsequent Scramble for Africa.

Title: Rabies vaccine
Blurb: Louis Pasteur creates the first successful vaccine against rabies for a young boy who had been bitten 14 times by a rabid dog.

Title: Vibrating Shuttle sewing machine
Blurb: Singer begins production of the Vibrating Shuttle, which would become the most popular model of sewing machine.

Title: Congo Free State
Blurb: King Leopold II of Belgium establishes the Congo Free State, a private government run by the International African Association.
Place: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo

Title: British Bechuanaland
Blurb: The United Kingdom establishes the Crown Colony of British Bechuanaland. Vryburg is the capital.

Title: Eastern Rumelia
Blurb: The Principality of Bulgaria annexes Eastern Rumelia.

Title: Konbaung dynasty
Blurb: The Third Anglo-Burmese War ends with the fall of the Konbaung dynasty in Burma.

Title: Ticalaco
Blurb: Peru manages to retain the town of Ticalaco which was considered to the south of the Sama River (defined as the border in the Ancon Treaty) by Chile but not by Peru. The Ticalaco River becomes the border in that part of the territory in the Tacna Province.

Title: Burma
Blurb: Burma becomes part of British India.

Title: Republic of Colombia
Blurb: The United States of Colombia becomes the Republic of Colombia.

Title: Transvaal
Blurb: Gold was discovered in Transvaal, leading to colonization in Southern Africa by the British and business interests, led by Cecil Rhodes.

Title: Boma
Blurb: King Leopold II of Belgium selects Boma as the capital of his Congo Free State.
Place: Boma, Democratic Republic of the Congo

Title: Statue of Liberty
Blurb: 1886: Construction of the Statue of Liberty; Coca-Cola is developed.
Place: New York, New York, United States

Title: Kingdom of Lunda
Blurb: The Kingdom of Lunda is disestablished.

Title: Macau
Blurb: Macau officially becomes a colony of Portugal.

Title: French Indochina
Blurb: The colony of French Indochina is established. Saigon is the capital.

Title: Sultanate of Maldives
Blurb: The Sultanate of Maldives becomes a British Protectorate.

Title: Brazil
Blurb: The Lei Aurea abolished slavery in Brazil in 1888.

Title: Bruneian Empire
Blurb: The Bruneian Empire becomes a protectorate of the United Kingdom.

Title: Kingdom of Sarawak
Blurb: The Kingdom of Sarawak becomes a protectorate of the United Kingdom.

Title: Minami-Tori-shima
Blurb: The United States of America claims Minami-Tori-shima using the Guano Islands Act.

Title: Sultanate of Maguindanao
Blurb: The Sultanate of Maguindanao falls after Mindanao is conquered by the Kingdom of Spain.

Title: Fanning Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom annexes Fanning Island, which was previously claimed by the United States of America.

Title: Christmas Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom claims Christmas Island, disputing a claim by the United States of America.

Title: Koninklijke Paketvaart-Maatschappij
Blurb: 1888: Founding of the shipping line Koninklijke Paketvaart-Maatschappij (KPM) that supported the unification and development of the colonial economy.

Title: Easter Island
Blurb: Chile incorporates Easter Island by signing a mutual will agreement with the island leader.

Title: Cook Islands
Blurb: The United Kingdom makes the Cook Islands a protectorate. This also creates a dispute with the United States of America on the atolls of Pukapuka, Manihiki, Penrhyn, and Rakahanga.

Title: Ahmadiyya Muslim Community
Blurb: Mirza Ghulam Ahmad establishes the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community.

Title: Aspirin
Blurb: Aspirin patented.

Title: Kingdom of Luba
Blurb: The Kingdom of Luba is annexed to the Congo Free State.
Place: Katanga, Democratic Republic of the Congo

Title: Russian flu pandemic
Blurb: 1889-1890: 1889-1890 pandemic kills 1 million people.

Title: Trinidad and Tobago
Blurb: The United Kingdom establishes the Crown Colony of Trinidad and Tobago from the colonies of Trinidad and Tobago.
Place: Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago

Title: Addis Ababa
Blurb: Emperor Menelik II of Ethiopia moves his capital to Addis Ababa.

Title: Eiffel Tower
Blurb: 1889: Eiffel Tower is inaugurated in Paris.

Title: Tarija and Puna de Atacama
Blurb: Argentina renounces to its claim over Tarija in exchange to Bolivia renouncing over its claim over Puna de Atacama in the Quirno Costa-Vaca Guzman treaty.

Title: Washington Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom annexes Washington Island, which was previously claimed by the United States of America.

Title: Jarvis Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom claims Jarvis Island, disputing a claim by the United States of America.

Title: Anglo-Egyptian Sudan
Blurb: Anglo-Egyptian Sudan is established as a colony of the United Kingdom.

Title: Sydney Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom claims Sydney Island, disputing a claim by the United States of America.

Title: Phoenix Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom claims Phoenix Island, disputing a claim by the United States of America.

Title: Birnie Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom claims Birnie Island, disputing a claim by the United States of America.

Title: Moulin Rouge
Blurb: 1889: Moulin Rouge opens in Paris.

Title: Heligoland
Blurb: Heligoland is ceded by the United Kingdom to the German Empire.

Title: Electric chair
Blurb: 1890: First use of the electric chair as a method of execution.

Title: Zanzibar
Blurb: Zanzibar becomes a protectorate of the United Kingdom.

Title: Grand Duchy of Luxembourg
Blurb: End of the personal union between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg.

Title: Basketball
Blurb: 1891: Basketball is invented by James Naismith.

Title: Hunza and Nagar
Blurb: Pratap Singh defeats the ruler of Chitral and forces Hunza and Nagar to accept the suzerainty of Kashmir and Jammu state.

Title: Rerum novarum
Blurb: Pope Leo XIII issues the papal encyclical Rerum novarum, the first major document informing modern Catholic social teaching.

Title: Fingerprinting
Blurb: 1892: Fingerprinting is officially adopted for the first time.

Title: Sultanate of Muscat and Oman
Blurb: The Sultanate of Muscat and Oman becomes a protectorate of the United Kingdom.

Title: World's Columbian Exposition
Blurb: 1892: The World's Columbian Exposition was held in Chicago celebrating the 400th anniversary of Christopher Columbus's arrival in the New World.

Title: Gilbert Islands
Blurb: The United Kingdom annexes the Gilbert Islands as a protectorate. This takes the islands of Butaritari and Marakei from the existing United States of America claim.

Title: Gardner Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom claims Gardner Island, disputing a claim by the United States of America.

Title: Nutcracker Suite
Blurb: 1892: Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker Suite premiered in St Petersburg.

Title: Belgium
Blurb: 1893: The Coremans-de Vriendt law is passed in Belgium, creating legal equality for French and Dutch languages.

Title: British Central Africa Protectorate
Blurb: The Nyasalands Districts Protectorate is renamed to the British Central Africa Protectorate of the United Kingdom. Zomba is the capital.

Title: Tierra del Fuego border
Blurb: Argentina and Chile agree to move their border in Tierra del Fuego 11.3 km to the west signing a protocol, as well as recognizing the coast of the Ultima Esperanza Province as Chilean in nowadays Puerto Natales.

Title: New Zealand
Blurb: 1893: New Zealand becomes the first country to enact women's suffrage.

Title: Kingdom of Luang Phrabang
Blurb: France conquers the Kingdom of Luang Phrabang from Siam and makes it part of French Indochina.

Title: Cakranegara Palace
Blurb: 1894: The Dutch intervention in Lombok and Karangasem resulted in the looting and destruction of Cakranegara Palace in Mataram. J. L. A. Brandes, a Dutch philologist, discovers and secures Nagarakretagama manuscript in Lombok royal library.

Title: Gramophone record
Blurb: First gramophone record.
Place: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

Title: Qing China
Blurb: After the First Sino-Japanese War, China cedes Taiwan to Japan and grants Japan a free hand in Korea, from 1894 to 1895.

Title: Swiss Army knife
Blurb: Karl Elsener invents the Swiss Army knife.

Title: Kingdom of Buganda
Blurb: The Kingdom of Buganda becomes a protectorate named Uganda of the United Kingdom. Entebbe is the capital.

Title: Alacrans Islands, Arenas Key and Western Triangle Island
Blurb: The United States of America rescinds its claims to the Alacrans Islands, Arenas Key, and Western Triangle Island, which were disputed with Mexico.

Title: Benz Omnibus
Blurb: Built for the Netphener bus company in 1895, the Benz Omnibus was the first motor bus in history.

Title: Cuba
Blurb: Cuban War for Independence results in Cuban independence from Spain, from 1895 to 1898.

Title: Taiwan
Blurb: Taiwan is ceded to the Empire of Japan as a result of the First Sino-Japanese War.

Title: Volleyball
Blurb: 1895: Volleyball is invented.

Title: Brazil and Argentina border
Blurb: The border between the Republic of the United States of Brazil and the Argentine Republic is arbitrated by U.S. President Grover Cleveland.

Title: Oscar Wilde
Blurb: 1895: Trial of Oscar Wilde and premiere of his play The Importance of Being Earnest.

Title: Republic of Formosa
Blurb: The Republic of Formosa declares independence upon its annexation by the Empire of Japan. Taipei is the capital.

Title: Tainan
Blurb: The Republic of Formosa moves its capital from Taipei to Tainan.

Title: East Africa Protectorate
Blurb: The United Kingdom establishes the East Africa Protectorate. Mombasa is the capital.

Title: Republic of Formosa
Blurb: The Empire of Japan conquers the Republic of Formosa. Taiwan becomes a Japanese colony under the name Takasago Koku. Taihoku is the capital.

Title: French West Africa
Blurb: France creates French West Africa. Saint-Louis is the capital.

Title: British Bechuanaland
Blurb: The United Kingdom annexes the Crown Colony of British Bechuanaland to the Cape Colony. Vryburg yields to Cape Town as the capital.

Title: Adwa
Blurb: Ethiopia defeated Italy in the First Italo-Ethiopian War at the Battle of Adwa.

Title: Philippines
Blurb: Philippine Revolution results in a Filipino victory, from 1896 to 1898.

Title: Radioactivity
Blurb: Henri Becquerel discovers radioactivity; J. J. Thomson identifies the electron, though not by name.

Title: Olympic Games
Blurb: The modern Olympic Games, first held in 1896, grew to include tens of thousands of athletes in dozens of sports.

Title: Korean Empire
Blurb: The Joseon Dynasty becomes the Korean Empire.

Title: Zulu Kingdom
Blurb: The Zulu Kingdom becomes part of the British Colony of Natal.

Title: Kingdom of Benin
Blurb: The United Kingdom invades the Kingdom of Benin and annexes it as part of its Niger Coast Protectorate.

Title: French Madagascar
Blurb: French Madagascar supersedes the Malagasy Protectorate following the exile of Ranavalona III.

Title: Africa
Blurb: In Africa, European exploration and technology led to the colonization of almost the entire continent by 1898. New medicines such as quinine and more advanced firearms allowed European nations to conquer native populations.

Title: La Paz
Blurb: The Republic of Bolivia moves its administrative capital from Sucre to La Paz. Sucre remains the constitutional and judicial capital.

Title: Spain
Blurb: Spanish-American War results in the independence of Cuba.

Title: Guangzhouwan
Blurb: After occupying the territory on April 22, France forces Qing China to lease it Guangzhouwan for a period of 99 years.

Title: New Territories
Blurb: Through the Convention for the Extension of Hong Kong Territory, Qing China lends New Territories to the United Kingdom for a period of 99 years.

Title: Philippine Republic
Blurb: The Philippine Republic declares independence from the Kingdom of Spain. Malolos is the capital.

Title: Minami-Tori-shima
Blurb: The Empire of Japan annexes Minami-Tori-shima, disputing a prior claim by the United States of America.

Title: Puerto Rico
Blurb: The United States of America seizes control of Puerto Rico from the Spanish Empire during the Spanish-American War.

Title: Territory of Hawaii
Blurb: The United States of America annexes the Republic of Hawaii as the Territory of Hawaii.

Title: Guangxu Emperor
Blurb: 1898: Empress Dowager Cixi of China engineers a coup d'etat, marking the end of the Hundred Days' Reform; the Guangxu Emperor is arrested.

Title: Puna de Atacama
Blurb: The Puna de Atacama dispute is resolved by arbitration: of the 75,000 square kilometres in dispute, 64,000 square kilometres, 85 percent, is awarded to the Argentina and 11,000 square kilometres, 15 percent, to the Republic of Chile.

Title: Captaincy General of Cuba
Blurb: The Spanish-American War concludes with the Treaty of Paris, by which the Monarchy of Spain cedes the Captaincy General of Cuba to the United States of America. Havana is the capital.

Title: Captaincy General of Puerto Rico
Blurb: The Spanish-American War concludes with the Treaty of Paris, by which the Monarchy of Spain cedes the Captaincy General of Puerto Rico to the United States of America. San Juan is the capital.

Title: Captaincy General of the Philippines
Blurb: The Spanish-American War concludes with the Treaty of Paris, by which Spain cedes the Captaincy General of the Philippines to the United States. Manila is the Spanish capital; the Philippine Republic maintains its sovereignty with Malolos as its capital.

Title: Island of Guam
Blurb: The Spanish-American War concludes with the Treaty of Paris, by which the Monarchy of Spain cedes the Island of Guam to the United States of America.

Title: Colombia
Blurb: Thousand Days' War in Colombia breaks out between the Liberales and Conservadores, culminating with the loss of Panama in 1903. Fought from 1899 to 1902.

Title: German New Guinea
Blurb: The German Empire takes over the administration of German New Guinea from the German New Guinea Company.

Title: Philippines
Blurb: Philippine-American War begins, lasting from 1899 to 1902.

Title: Qing China
Blurb: Boxer Rebellion in China is suppressed by the Eight-Nation Alliance, from 1899 to 1901.

Title: South African Republic
Blurb: Second Boer War begins, lasting from 1899 to 1902.

Title: Wake Island
Blurb: The United States of America claims Wake Island.

Title: Sheikhdom of Kuwait
Blurb: The Sheikhdom of Kuwait becomes a protectorate of the United Kingdom.

Title: Caroline Islands and Mariana Islands
Blurb: The German-Spanish Treaty is signed. Spain sells the Bismarck Archipelago, Bougainville, Buka, the Caroline Islands including Palau, and the Mariana Islands to Germany for 25 million pesetas. The new territories are placed under German New Guinea.

Title: British Solomon Islands
Blurb: Following the Tripartite Convention, the islands east and southeast of Bougainville belonging to German New Guinea are ceded to the British Solomon Islands.

Title: Kingdom of Samoa
Blurb: Following the Tripartite Convention, the Kingdom of Samoa is partitioned between German Samoa and American Samoa.

Title: West African neutral zone
Blurb: Following the Tripartite Convention, the neutral zone in West Africa is split between British Gold Coast and German Togoland.

Title: American League Baseball
Blurb: American League Baseball was formed in 1900 and in 1903, both National and American agreed to play in the first World Series with over 100,000 in attendance.

Title: Northern Nigeria
Blurb: The Northern Nigeria Protectorate and Southern Nigeria Protectorate are established by the United Kingdom.

Title: Oiapoque
Blurb: The border between Brazil and the French colony of Guyane (French Guiana) is defined by arbitration. French troops that advanced to the margins of the Araguari River repair to the Oiapoque River.

Title: Pentecostalism
Blurb: 1900s - A number of related revival movements mark the start of Pentecostalism.

Title: Qing China
Blurb: The Eight-Nation Alliance - Austria-Hungary, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Russia, the United Kingdom and the United States - forms to invade Qing China, representing the club of great powers at the start of the 20th century.

Title: American Samoa
Blurb: The United States of America takes control of American Samoa under the terms of the Tripartite Convention.

Title: Acre
Blurb: The First Republic of Acre capitulates and is reabsorbed by the Republic of Bolivia.

Title: Exposition Universelle
Blurb: 1900: Exposition Universelle held in Paris, prominently featuring the growing art trend Art Nouveau.

Title: Niue
Blurb: The United Kingdom annexes the island of Niue, making it a British protectorate.

Title: Orange Free State
Blurb: The United Kingdom occupies the Orange Free State.

Title: Forbidden City
Blurb: 1900-1901: Eight nations invade China at the same time and ransack Forbidden City.

Title: Chad
Blurb: The colony of French Chad is established. Fort-Lamy is the capital.

Title: Acre
Blurb: Acre declares independence from Bolivia as the Second Republic of Acre. The movement is quickly suppressed and Acre remains part of Bolivia.

Title: Philippines
Blurb: The First Philippine Republic dissolves.

Title: Cook Islands
Blurb: The United Kingdom transfers the Cook Islands and Niue to the Colony of New Zealand.

Title: Ashanti Empire
Blurb: The United Kingdom occupies the Ashanti Empire and makes it a Crown colony.

Title: Mandara Kingdom
Blurb: German Kamerun annexes the Mandara Kingdom.

Title: Zaria
Blurb: The Zaria Emirate and the Abuja Emirate are annexed into the British Northern Nigeria Protectorate.

Title: Papua
Blurb: The Crown colony of British New Guinea is transferred from the United Kingdom to Australia, which reorganizes it as the Territory of Papua.

Title: Cuba
Blurb: The Republic of Cuba gains independence from the United States of America. Havana is the capital.

Title: Orange River Colony
Blurb: The United Kingdom creates the Orange River Colony from the Orange Free State and the Transvaal Colony from the South African Republic. Bloemfontein and Pretoria remain the respective capitals.

Title: Henderson Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom annexes Henderson Island.

Title: Oeno Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom annexes Oeno Island.

Title: Andes
Blurb: King Edward VII of Britain adjusts borders in the Cordillera of the Andes Boundary Case between Chile and Argentina.

Title: Ducie Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom annexes Ducie Island.

Title: Aceh
Blurb: After the Aceh War, the Sultanate of Aceh is annexed by the Kingdom of the Netherlands and becomes part of the Dutch East Indies.

Title: Seychelles
Blurb: The United Kingdom secedes the Seychelles from the colony of Mauritius.

Title: Acre
Blurb: The Third Republic of Acre declares its independence from Bolivia. The capital is Cidade do Acre.

Title: Guantanamo Bay
Blurb: Cuba leases Guantanamo Bay to the United States of America in perpetuity.

Title: Mauritania
Blurb: Mauritania becomes a protectorate of the French Republic. Saint-Louis is the capital.

Title: Adamawa Emirate
Blurb: The Adamawa Emirate is annexed into the British Northern Nigeria Protectorate and German Kamerun.

Title: Alaska
Blurb: The Alaska boundary dispute is resolved between the United States of America and Canada.

Title: Acre
Blurb: Bolivia and Brazil sign the Treaty of Petropolis. Bolivia receives land in Mato Grosso from Brazil, and Brazil absorbs the Republic of Acre.

Title: Panama Canal Zone
Blurb: The new Republic of Panama grants the United States of America control of the Panama Canal Zone. Balboa is the administrative center.

Title: Kitty Hawk
Blurb: First flight of the Wright brothers' Wright Flyer in 1903 in Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, US; Orville piloting with Wilbur running at wingtip. With the engineering of the faster jet engine in the 1940s, mass air travel became commercially viable.
Place: Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, United States

Title: British Guiana
Blurb: The border between Brazil and British Guiana is defined by arbitration. Approximately half of the disputed land goes to each side.

Title: Champasak
Blurb: The Kingdom of Champasak is annexed by France and becomes part of the French protectorate of Laos.

Title: Dahomey
Blurb: French Dahomey is established. Porto-Novo is the capital.

Title: Manchuria
Blurb: Russo-Japanese War, between the Russian Empire and the Empire of Japan during 1904 and 1905 over rival imperial ambitions in Manchuria and the Korean Empire.

Title: Thelema
Blurb: 1904 - Aleister Crowley dictates The Book of the Law, the foundational text of Thelema.

Title: Chantaburi
Blurb: Following the Franco-Siamese Convention, the Kingdom of Siam concedes border territories to French Indochina in exchange for French-occupied Chantaburi.

Title: Panama Canal Zone
Blurb: The United States of America annexes the Panama Canal Zone.

Title: Saguia el-Hamra
Blurb: The Franco-Spanish Convention of Paris acknowledges formal control of Saguia el-Hamra (later northern Spanish Sahara) by the Kingdom of Spain.

Title: Nairobi
Blurb: The United Kingdom moves the capital of the East Africa Protectorate from Mombasa to Nairobi.

Title: Pittsburgh
Blurb: The first modern movie theatre was established in Pittsburgh in 1905.

Title: Russian Empire
Blurb: The Russian Revolution of 1905: a wave of mass political and social unrest spreads across the Russian Empire, directed mainly against the Tsar, the nobility and the ruling class, and including worker strikes, peasant unrest and military mutinies.

Title: Norway
Blurb: The Kingdom of Norway declares its independence from the United Kingdoms of Sweden and Norway through dissolution of the personal union with Sweden.

Title: Liaodong Peninsula
Blurb: The Liaodong Peninsula and the Russian railway in south Manchuria are leased to the Empire of Japan following the Treaty of Portsmouth.

Title: Sakhalin
Blurb: The Empire of Japan annexes Sakhalin Island south of 50 degrees N following the Treaty of Portsmouth.

Title: Middle Congo

Title: New Hebrides
Blurb: The United Kingdom and France jointly administer the New Hebrides. Port Vila is the capital.

Title: Triode tube
Blurb: The triode tube was invented, laying the foundation for amplification and switching technologies that led to silicon-based solid-state transistors, which revolutionized modern electronics.
Place: New York, New York, United States

Title: Southern Nigeria
Blurb: The British Colony of Lagos and the Southern Nigeria Protectorate merge to form the Colony and Protectorate of Southern Nigeria.

Title: Trat
Blurb: The Kingdom of Siam concedes territory to French Indochina in exchange for Trat.

Title: Cabeca do Cachorro

Title: Nyasaland
Blurb: The British Central Africa Protectorate is renamed to Nyasaland Protectorate.

Title: New Zealand
Blurb: New Zealand becomes a Dominion within the British Empire under the name Dominion of New Zealand. Wellington is the capital. The Dominion of Newfoundland is also declared the same day.

Title: Bulgaria
Blurb: The Kingdom of Bulgaria gains independence from the Ottoman Empire. Sofia is the capital.

Title: Bosnia and Herzegovina
Blurb: Austria-Hungary formally annexes the Ottoman Vilayet of Bosnia as the Condominium of Bosnia and Herzegovina, causing the Bosnian crisis.

Title: Belgian Congo
Blurb: King Leopold II of Belgium sells his private Congo Free State to the Kingdom of Belgium. The colony is renamed the Belgian Congo.

Title: British Malaya
Blurb: The Kingdom of Siam transfers its southernmost provinces to British Malaya in the Anglo-Siamese Treaty of 1909.

Title: Kasanje Kingdom
Blurb: The Kasanje Kingdom is annexed to Portuguese Angola.

Title: French Equatorial Africa
Blurb: The French Republic creates French Equatorial Africa from its colonies of Gabon, Middle Congo, and Oubangui-Chari. Brazzaville becomes the capital.

Title: Rio Grande bancos
Blurb: 23 bancos are annexed by Mexico from the United States and 34 bancos are annexed by the United States from Mexico with the first application of the Banco Convention of 1905.

Title: Pope's Folly Island
Blurb: Canada rescinds its claim to Pope's Folly Island in a treaty with the United States of America.

Title: Korea
Blurb: The Korean Empire capitulates and is annexed by the Empire of Japan.

Title: Portugal
Blurb: The First Portuguese Republic supersedes the Kingdom of Portugal.

Title: Northern Rhodesia
Blurb: The United Kingdom unites Barotziland-North-Western Rhodesia and North-Eastern Rhodesia to form Northern Rhodesia.

Title: Neukamerun
Blurb: In the Morocco-Congo Treaty, Germany acquires the Neukamerun region from France in exchange for abandoning German claims in Morocco.

Title: China
Blurb: The Republic of China overthrows the Qing dynasty of China in the Xinhai Revolution. Nanking is the provisional capital.

Title: Qing dynasty
Blurb: After a long period of civil wars and conflicts with western powers, China's last imperial dynasty ended in 1912.

Title: Wadai Empire
Blurb: The Wadai Empire is disestablished and annexed into French Chad.

Title: Morocco
Blurb: The Treaty of Fez formally re-establishes Morocco as a French Protectorate.

Title: RMS Titanic
Blurb: RMS Titanic sinks in the North Atlantic on 15 April 1912. The largest ocean liner in service at the time, she was four days into her maiden voyage from Southampton to New York with an estimated 2,224 people aboard when she struck an iceberg late on 14 April.

Title: Rio Grande bancos
Blurb: Mexico annexes 20 bancos from the United States and the United States annexes 11 bancos from Mexico.

Title: Spanish Morocco
Blurb: The Treaty Between France and Spain Regarding Morocco assigns the northern and southern strips of Morocco to Spain.

Title: Tibet
Blurb: Tibet declares independence from the Republic of China.

Title: Oman
Blurb: The Imamate of Oman rebels against the Sultanate of Muscat and Oman. Nizwa becomes the capital after it is conquered on 5 June.

Title: Epirus
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Bucharest, Greece gains Epirus, West Macedonia, Central Macedonia, and most of the Aegean islands it did not control before the war.

Title: Kosovo
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Bucharest, Serbia gains Kosovo, most of what is now North Macedonia, and land to the west of its previous borders.

Title: Southern Dobruja
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Bucharest, Romania gains Southern Dobruja.

Title: Western Thrace
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Bucharest, Bulgaria gains Western Thrace and the southern portions of what are now Blagoevgrad Province and Burgas Province.

Title: Constantinople
Blurb: Following the Second Balkan War, the Treaty of Constantinople is signed. The Ottoman Empire regains the portions of Eastern Thrace lost in the First Balkan War, and loses all other European territory west of the Enez-Kiyikoy line.

Title: Kingdom of Kongo
Blurb: The Kingdom of Kongo is annexed to Portuguese Angola.

Title: Nigeria
Blurb: The United Kingdom unites the Colony and Protectorate of Southern Nigeria and the Northern Nigeria Protectorate to form the Colony and Protectorate of Nigeria. Lagos is the capital.

Title: World War I
Blurb: Rising nationalism and national awareness were among the many causes of World War I (1914-1918), the first of two wars involving most major powers including Germany, France, Italy, Japan, Russia, the British Empire and the United States.

Title: Albania
Blurb: Albania becomes the Principality of Albania.

Title: Tannu Uriankhai
Blurb: Tannu Uriankhai is officially made a protectorate of the Russian Empire.

Title: Serbia
Blurb: Following the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand, Austria-Hungary declares war on Serbia, precipitating the First World War.

Title: Petrograd
Blurb: The Russian Empire changes the name of its capital from Saint Petersburg to Petrograd.

Title: Ottoman Empire
Blurb: The Armenian, Assyrian and Greek genocide were the systematic destruction, mass murder and expulsion of the Armenians, Assyrians and Greeks in the Ottoman Empire during World War I, spearheaded by the ruling Committee of Union and Progress (CUP).

Title: Panama Canal Zone
Blurb: The Panama Canal Zone border is redefined between Panama and the United States, resulting in slight territory changes.

Title: Rio Chagres
Blurb: The United States annexes more land around the Rio Chagres mouth in the Panama Canal Zone due to the Hay-Bunau-Varilla Treaty.

Title: Warsaw
Blurb: The German Empire creates the Government General of Warsaw from the parts of Poland conquered from the Russian Empire.

Title: Panama Canal Zone
Blurb: The United States annexes a triangle of island between the Rio Chagres, Caribbean Sea and the Panama Canal Zone.

Title: Arab Revolt
Blurb: The Arab Revolt, an armed uprising against the Ottoman Empire by the Arabs in agreement with Britain and France. Led by Sharif Hussein bin Ali, who was promised control of all Ottoman Arab lands in exchange for fighting - a promise Britain and France did not honour.

Title: Empire of China
Blurb: The Empire of China is abolished.

Title: Kingdom of Poland
Blurb: Germany and Austria-Hungary proclaim the establishment of the Kingdom of Poland. Warsaw is the capital.

Title: Europe and Asia
Blurb: The Revolutions of 1917-1923 occurred during and after World War I, inspired by the Russian Revolution, which saw many political changes in Europe and in Asia.

Title: Russia
Blurb: During World War I, in the Russian Revolution of 1917, 300 years of Tsarist reign were ended and the Bolsheviks, under the leadership of Vladimir Lenin, established the world's first Communist state.

Title: Russia
Blurb: The Provisional Government of Russia supersedes the Russian Empire in the wake of the February Revolution.

Title: United States Virgin Islands
Blurb: Under the Treaty of the Danish West Indies, the United States acquires the Danish West Indies from Denmark, renaming them the United States Virgin Islands.

Title: Estonia
Blurb: The Autonomous Governorate of Estonia is created from the Governorate of Estonia and part of the Governorate of Livonia of the Russian Empire.

Title: China
Blurb: Xuantong is reinstalled as Emperor of China in an event now called the Manchu Restoration.

Title: China
Blurb: End of the Manchu Restoration in China.

Title: Russian Republic
Blurb: The Russian Republic supersedes the Provisional Government of Russia.

Title: Russian SFSR
Blurb: The Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic supersedes the Russian Republic.

Title: Estonia
Blurb: The Provincial Assembly of the Autonomous Governorate of Estonia declares itself the only legally constituted authority in Estonia, de facto declaring sovereignty from the Russian SFSR.

Title: Chechenia
Blurb: The Emirate of Chechenia declares its independence from the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic. Vedeno is the capital.

Title: Flanders
Blurb: The Independent State of Flanders declares its independence from the Kingdom of Belgium. Brussels is the capital.

Title: Central Powers
Blurb: The end of World War I saw the collapse of the central powers, the German Empire, the Austrian-Hungarian Empire, the Kingdom of Bulgaria, and the Ottoman Empire into several independent sovereign states throughout Central Europe, the Balkans, and the Middle East.

Title: Osage Nation
Blurb: The Osage Murders of 1918-1931 were a series of killings of members of the Native American Osage Nation, who were the richest people per capita in the world at that time.

Title: Spanish Flu
Blurb: An influenza pandemic, Spanish Flu, killed anywhere from 17 to 100 million people between 1918 and 1919.

Title: Narva
Blurb: After a plebiscite in Narva, the town and its Ivangorod district across the Narva River are ceded from the Saint Petersburg Governorate to the Autonomous Governorate of Estonia.

Title: Ukraine
Blurb: The Ukrainian People's Republic gains independence from the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic. Kiev is the capital.

Title: Lithuania
Blurb: The State of Lithuania declares its independence from the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic. Vilnius is named the capital.

Title: Moscow
Blurb: The Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic moves its capital from Petrograd to Moscow.

Title: Abkhazia
Blurb: The Abkhazian Republic gains independence from the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic. Sukhumi is the capital.

Title: Belarus
Blurb: The Belarusian People's Republic declares its independence from the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic. Minsk and Hrodna are named the joint capitals.

Title: Bessarabia
Blurb: The Union of Bessarabia with Romania is proclaimed.

Title: Abkhazia
Blurb: The Transcaucasian Democratic Federative Republic declares independence from the Russian SFSR and annexes the Abkhazian Republic.

Title: Transcaucasia
Blurb: The Transcaucasian Democratic Federative Republic gains independence from the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic. Tbilisi is the capital.

Title: Chechenia
Blurb: The Mountainous Republic of the Northern Caucasus annexes the Emirate of Chechenia.

Title: Armenia
Blurb: Armenia changes its name to the Democratic Republic of Armenia.

Title: Lithuania
Blurb: The Kingdom of Lithuania supersedes the State of Lithuania.

Title: Russian SFSR
Blurb: The Russian Socialist Federative Soviet Republic supersedes the Soviet Russian Republic.

Title: Punta Paitilla
Blurb: The United States annexes 2.6 hectares of land at Punta Paitilla for the Panama Canal Zone.

Title: Flanders
Blurb: The Kingdom of Belgium reabsorbs the Independent State of Flanders.

Title: Quebrada Majagual
Blurb: The United States annexes land between Rio Chagres and Quebrada Majagual for the Panama Canal Zone.

Title: Hungary
Blurb: The Kingdom of Hungary declares the monarchy abolished. Budapest is the capital.

Title: West Ukraine
Blurb: The short-lived West Ukrainian People's Republic is proclaimed.

Title: Yemen
Blurb: The Mutawakkilite Kingdom of Yemen (North Yemen) gains independence from the Ottoman Empire. Sana'a becomes its capital.

Title: Lithuania
Blurb: The Republic of Lithuania supersedes the Kingdom of Lithuania.

Title: Alsace-Lorraine
Blurb: The Republic of Alsace-Lorraine is proclaimed. Strasbourg is the capital.

Title: Poland
Blurb: The Republic of Poland supersedes the Kingdom of Poland.

Title: Banat
Blurb: The Kingdom of Serbia invades the short-lived Banat Republic and divides it between the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes and Romania.

Title: Hungary
Blurb: The Hungarian People's Republic supersedes the Kingdom of Hungary.

Title: Alsace-Lorraine
Blurb: France annexes the Republic of Alsace-Lorraine.

Title: Vojvodina
Blurb: The de facto province of Vojvodina votes to join with the Kingdom of Serbia.

Title: Bukovina
Blurb: The Union of Bukovina with Romania is proclaimed.

Title: Montenegro
Blurb: The Kingdom of Serbia annexes the Kingdom of Montenegro.

Title: Estonia
Blurb: The Commune of the Working People of Estonia is established as a puppet state in Soviet Russian-occupied Estonia.

Title: Transylvania
Blurb: The Union of Transylvania with Romania is proclaimed.

Title: Slovakia
Blurb: The Slovak People's Republic is established.

Title: Slovakia
Blurb: The Slovak People's Republic is disestablished, merged into the First Czechoslovak Republic.

Title: Byelorussia
Blurb: The Socialist Soviet Republic of Byelorussia supersedes the Belarusian People's Republic. Minsk and Smolensk remain joint capitals.

Title: Upper Volta
Blurb: French West Africa is reorganized, with Upper Volta as a separate colony.

Title: Hutsul Republic
Blurb: The Hutsul Republic is established.

Title: Lithuania-Belorussia
Blurb: The Lithuanian-Belorussian Soviet Socialist Republic supersedes the Socialist Soviet Republic of Byelorussia. Vilnius is the capital.

Title: Uruguay
Blurb: The Oriental State of Uruguay changes its name to the Oriental Republic of Uruguay.

Title: Hungary
Blurb: The Hungarian Soviet Republic supersedes the Hungarian People's Republic.

Title: Bavaria
Blurb: The Bavarian Soviet Republic supersedes the People's State of Bavaria.

Title: Vilnius
Blurb: Poland occupies Vilnius, which is disputed by the Lithuanians.

Title: Bavaria
Blurb: The Free State of Bavaria supersedes the Bavarian Soviet Republic.

Title: Kamerun
Blurb: Kamerun and Togoland are assigned to France and the United Kingdom as mandates, respectively.

Title: Kionga Triangle
Blurb: The Kionga Triangle is assigned to Portugal as a mandate.

Title: Nauru
Blurb: Nauru is assigned to the British Empire (eventually the United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand) as a mandate.

Title: New Guinea
Blurb: German New Guinea and the Bismarck Archipelago are assigned to Australia as a mandate.

Title: South Seas Mandate
Blurb: The German Northern Pacific Islands are assigned to Japan as the South Seas Mandate.

Title: South West Africa
Blurb: German Southwest Africa is assigned to South Africa as a mandate under the name South West Africa.

Title: Western Samoa
Blurb: German Samoa is assigned to New Zealand as a mandate under the name Territory of Western Samoa.

Title: Ruanda-Urundi
Blurb: Ruanda and Urundi (minus Kisaka district) are assigned to Belgium as a mandate.

Title: Hutsul Republic
Blurb: The Hutsul Republic is disestablished, incorporated into the First Czechoslovak Republic.

Title: Alsace-Lorraine
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Versailles, Alsace-Lorraine is officially ceded to France.

Title: Danzig
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Versailles, Danzig and the surrounding area are superseded by the Free City of Danzig, administered by the League of Nations.

Title: Eupen-Malmedy
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Versailles, Eupen-Malmedy and Neutral Moresnet are ceded to Belgium.

Title: Memel
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Versailles, Memel and Saarland are put under international administration.

Title: Posen
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Versailles, the Second Polish Republic is established in place of the puppet Kingdom of Poland, and most of Posen and West Prussia are ceded to Poland by Germany.

Title: Upper Silesia
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Versailles, plebiscites are provided for in Schleswig and Upper Silesia.

Title: Versailles
Blurb: In the aftermath of World War I, the Treaty of Versailles and the Little Treaty of Versailles are signed, redrawing the borders of Europe.

Title: Cameroons
Blurb: France and the United Kingdom agree on a frontier between their mandates in the Cameroons.

Title: Hungary
Blurb: The Hungarian People's Republic supersedes the Hungarian Soviet Republic.

Title: Afghanistan
Blurb: Afghanistan declares its independence from the United Kingdom.

Title: Hungary
Blurb: The Hungarian Republic supersedes the Hungarian People's Republic.

Title: Germany
Blurb: The German Reich supersedes the German Empire.

Title: Bukovina
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye, Romanian sovereignty over Bukovina is recognized.

Title: Czechoslovakia
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye, the independence of Poland, Czechoslovakia, and the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes is recognized.

Title: Eastern Galicia
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye, Eastern Galicia is ceded to Poland.

Title: Saint-Germain-en-Laye
Blurb: Austria signs the Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye, ceding territory and recognizing new successor states.

Title: South Tyrol
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye, South Tyrol, Trentino, Trieste, and Istria are ceded to Italy.

Title: Italian Libya
Blurb: The Bonin-Pichon agreement transfers two desert strips from French control to Italian Libya.

Title: Largo Remo
Blurb: The United States of America annexes the island of Largo Remo for the Panama Canal Zone.

Title: Spitsbergen
Blurb: Spitsbergen is awarded to Norway.

Title: Dobruja
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Neuilly-sur-Seine, Dobruja is returned to the Kingdom of Romania.

Title: Neuilly-sur-Seine
Blurb: Bulgaria signs the Treaty of Neuilly-sur-Seine, ceding Western Thrace to the Entente and land to the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes.

Title: Western Thrace
Blurb: Under the Treaty of Neuilly-sur-Seine, Western Thrace is ceded by Bulgaria to the Entente.
